title: Lamp Oil
summary: Pim Rushlight knows what burns, and the vats under the Canal Locks burn better than anything he sells. Hold eight waves down there, and he'll show your mages how to keep a fire off somebody (the mage's level-12 skill).

steps.journal: Hold eight waves at Vat Seven, the Canal Locks' third floor, among the old vats.

ready: Go back to Pim Rushlight, at his handcart by Saltmere's cistern.
done: Pim taught your mages Arcane Ward. He charged nothing, and told you so three times.
